name: spyglass
description: Firstmate Spyglass for Claude Code: a read-only live fleet view with a status-line summary, a /fleet pane, per-worker session panes, toasts when something needs the captain, and a Firstmate update flag. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollout flag, but the mod activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.
